1.
Exemption allowed subject to all just exceptions.
2. Application stands disposed of.

1. This petition has been filed seeking quashing of FIR No.54/2017 under sections 498A/406/34 IPC PS Sagarpur on the ground that the parties have arrived at a settlement with the intervention of common friends, relatives and respectable persons of the society.
2. Petitioner nos. 1 to 3 and respondent no.2-complainant are present in the Court have been duly identified by the Investigating Officer and their respective counsels.
3. Marriage of petitioner No. 1 and respondent No. 2 has since been dissolved vide decree of divorce by mutual consent dated 4th October, 2021; one female child was born out of wedlock.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 24/09/2023 at 14:54:24 4.
Respondent no.2 has confirmed the factum of settlement and states that she has no objection to the quashing of the FIR as the settlement amount of Rs.3,50,000/- has already been received by her.

5. Considering the above settlement between the parties and the chances of conviction of the petitioners being remote and bleak, there is no use continuing with proceedings of the present FIR Manoj Kumar And Ors vs The State And Anr on 18 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/45356609/
1 as it would be a misuse of the process of the Court and an unnecessary burden on the State exchequer.

sentences.text: Accordingly, the petition is allowed.
Consequently, the FIR No.54/2017 under sections 498A/406/34 IPC PS Sagarpur and proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed.
It is however made clear that the said settlement will not affect the rights of the minor child in future.
6. Parties shall abide by the terms of settlement.
7. Petition stands disposed of accordingly.
8. Pending applications (if any) are disposed of as infructuous.
9. Order be uploaded on the website of this Court.
ANISH DAYAL, J MAY 18, 2023/
